gamerule.physicsbruhh.physical_goo: Honey and slime behave like goo
gamerule.physicsbruhh.physical_goo.descr: Placed or piston-moved honey and slime blocks melt, wobble and stretch instead of staying rigid blocks. Turn off to keep vanilla contraptions working.

gamerule.physicsbruhh.physical_gas: Fire and smoke are physical gas
gamerule.physicsbruhh.physical_gas.descr: Fire, campfires, torches, lava, lit furnaces, burning creatures and explosions make flames and smoke that are simulated as gas: they rise, swirl, go round blocks and gather under ceilings. Each client computes and draws them for itself (/gaslook).
